The '''Tebru system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tebru]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] collector [[Toria Tell]] maintained a residence on Tebru during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Toria Tell's Droid Journal" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tebru system was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square P-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
